title: PMRNet: Physics-informed Multi-scale Refinement Network for Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Physics-informed multi-scale CNN; boundary-aware decoding and efficient context propagation
summary: Combines a boundary-sensitive encoder, downsampling intended to preserve information, a diffusion-based context module, and a boundary-focused decoder.
proposed_diagnostic: Compare against a conventional multi-scale CNN with matched input geometry, whole-model latency, memory, and small-structure/surface metrics.
review_cutoff_status: Before review cutoff; not in frozen 95-family inventory

title: MedCLIPSeg: Probabilistic Vision-Language Adaptation for Data-Efficient and Generalizable Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Probabilistic cross-modal image–text attention; uncertainty-aware vision-language adaptation
summary: Adapts patch-level CLIP features through probabilistic image–text interaction and a soft contrastive objective; studies predictive uncertainty and transfer.
proposed_diagnostic: Hold the text-prompt set and pretraining fixed; compare probabilistic attention with deterministic attention across label fractions and untouched test domains.
review_cutoff_status: Before review cutoff; not in frozen 95-family inventory

title: VoxTell: Free-Text Promptable Universal 3D Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Volumetric vision-language foundation segmentation; multi-stage text/3D feature fusion
summary: Produces 3D masks from free-form text descriptions using multi-stage fusion of volumetric features and language representations.
proposed_diagnostic: Evaluate unseen anatomical concepts and acquisition sites with a fixed prompt-information budget; report prompting burden and volumetric consistency.
review_cutoff_status: Before review cutoff; not in frozen 95-family inventory

title: HEDS-Net: A Hybrid State-Space Architecture with Axial Bridge and Progressive Weighting for Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Hybrid vision SSM; axial cross-information skip bridge; progressive deep supervision
summary: Combines sequential context propagation with multi-scale enhancement, an axial bridge across features, and dynamically weighted auxiliary supervision.
proposed_diagnostic: Ablate the bridge, state-space path, and deep-supervision weighting independently; compare surface error and measured inference cost.

title: VM-NeXT UNet: Synergizing ConvNeXT and Visual Mamba for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Parallel ConvNeXT and visual-SSM encoders; channel–spatial skip gating; multi-scale decoder
summary: Integrates CNN local feature extraction and visual state propagation with input-adaptive skip transfer and multi-scale reconstruction.
proposed_diagnostic: Use matched encoder/decoder capacity to isolate the contribution of dual encoding, gating, and loss design; measure boundary fidelity and latency.

title: Glasses: Adapter-Enhanced DINOv3 with Boundary-Aware Multi-Scale Representations for Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: DINOv3 adapter; multi-scale deformable attention; independent edge-aware convolutional encoder
summary: Adapts pretrained DINOv3 representations through multi-scale structural priors while learning explicit boundary cues in a complementary CNN branch.
proposed_diagnostic: Hold DINOv3 initialization constant and contrast adapter-only, boundary-branch-only, and combined designs under matched resource budgets.

title: Segment Anything Model with Symmetric Spectral Uncertainty Gating for Generalizable Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: SAM adaptation; spectral manifold extrapolation; uncertainty-aware channel gating
summary: Combines spectral style perturbation with uncertainty-guided channel calibration and hierarchical consistency for single-source domain generalization.
proposed_diagnostic: Separate spectral augmentation from gating and consistency; evaluate unseen institutions with matched preprocessing and calibration.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Spatio-Semantic Contextual Prompts for Multimodal Medical Segmentation
authors: Soumitri Chattopadhyay, Başar Demir, and Marc Niethammer
mechanism: Frozen SAM-Med3D; spatial registration and semantic priors; confidence-gated dense prompting
summary: Fuses registration-derived spatial context and semantic feature matching into a dense prompt for a frozen volumetric foundation model.
proposed_diagnostic: Use the same support cases and target-label ontology to compare spatial-only, semantic-only, and uncertainty-gated fusion across modalities.

title: Modality-Agnostic Domain Generalizable Medical Image Segmentation via Self-Coordinated Focusing
mechanism: Dynamic focusing convolution; interactive attention fusion decoder
summary: Uses target-aware dynamic receptive-field selection and interaction across decoder semantic hierarchies to address cross-modality changes.
proposed_diagnostic: Evaluate untouched hospitals/modalities with a common label space; separately ablate dynamic convolution and interactive fusion.

title: BDFR-Net: Boundary-Aware Dual-Domain Feature Reconstruction Network for Fetal Ultrasound Image Segmentation
mechanism: Frequency–spatial feature reconstruction; adaptive skip alignment for ultrasound boundaries
summary: Combines frequency-decoupled edge features with spatial context and attention-based cross-layer alignment for low-contrast fetal ultrasound.
proposed_diagnostic: Factorially compare frequency features, spatial boundary supervision, and skip alignment; report noise sensitivity and independent-center transfer.

title: Dual-Adaptive SAM3: Hierarchical Routing over Low-Rank Expert Layers for Parameter-Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: SAM3 adaptation; task-aware sparse expert routing; shared-base low-rank experts
summary: Uses joint visual/text routing to select low-rank expert updates on a shared pretrained backbone; the paper reports parameter and FLOP reductions.
proposed_diagnostic: Measure full inference latency and memory, router utilization, and held-out domain transfer versus matched PEFT and MoE baselines.

title: Conformal 3D Lesion Segmentation with Balanced Risk Control
mechanism: Model-agnostic conformal post-processing; false-negative risk control
summary: Calibrates segmentation thresholds on held-out data to control lesion false-negative risk under exchangeability; this is a post-processor, not a new network architecture.
proposed_diagnostic: Report per-case coverage validity, false positives, and reliability under distribution shift with independent calibration/test partitions.
review_cutoff_status: After 2026-06-30 review cutoff; contextual evaluation method only
